name: Stanley Raghoebarsing
detail: Minister of Finance and Planning; argued against wealth taxation in DNA plenary debate on 2024-06-11, questioning solidarity and defending those who accumulate wealth through hard work against having to share it.

name: Stanley A. Esajas
detail: Tax jurist who authored 'Belastingdruk en Inflatie in de Surinaamse Politieke Economie' in VES Inzicht (May 2025); analyzes wealth tax erosion and bracket creep through inflation without stating a personal recommendation or proposal for a wealth tax.
